primaryGoal: Track weekly cumulative KPI performance (M1 ACV, M1 Count, S0 ACV) from the start of the current quarter to identify week-over-week changes, trends, and progress toward targets.
assumptions: The date columns [Opportunity M1 Date] and [Opportunity S0 Date] are accurate and represent the appropriate milestone dates for M1 and S0 opportunities respectively.
The current quarter is defined by the system's quarter_number function and 'this quarter' filter returns data for the ongoing quarter.
Weekly granularity is consistently defined across the dataset, and the 'weekly' filter returns data aggregated by week.
The mandatory filters ([Opportunity Type] IN ('existing customer expansion', 'new customer') AND [Opportunity Deployment] != 'mode') apply to all opportunities in the dataset.
The cumulative_sum function correctly restarts at the beginning of each quarter based on the quarter_number partition.
Data is available for at least two complete weeks in the current quarter to calculate week-over-week changes.

phases.phaseTitle: M1 ACV Weekly Cumulative Performance Tracking
phases.phaseDescription: Calculate the cumulative M1 ACV from the start of the current quarter on a weekly basis, identify the previous week and current week values, and compute week-over-week change and percentage change to understand M1 ACV trending.

fetchSteps.title: Fetch 1: M1 ACV Cumulative by Week for Current Quarter
fetchSteps.objective: Retrieve the cumulative sum of M1 ACV by week for the current quarter, restarting the cumulative calculation at each quarter boundary.
fetchSteps.requiredData: Columns: Weekly aggregation of [Opportunity M1 Date], cumulative_sum([Opportunity M1 Starting ACV], [Opportunity M1 Date], quarter_number([Opportunity M1 Date])). Filters: [Opportunity M1 Date] granularity is 'weekly', [Opportunity M1 Date] is 'this quarter', [Opportunity Type] IN ('existing customer expansion', 'new customer'), [Opportunity Deployment] != 'mode'.
fetchSteps.fetchPrompt: Calculate the cumulative sum of [Opportunity M1 Starting ACV] by [Opportunity M1 Date], restarting for each quarter using the formula cumulative_sum([Opportunity M1 Starting ACV], [Opportunity M1 Date], quarter_number([Opportunity M1 Date])). Apply filters: [Opportunity M1 Date] at weekly granularity, [Opportunity M1 Date] is 'this quarter', [Opportunity Type] is either 'existing customer expansion' or 'new customer', and [Opportunity Deployment] is not 'mode'. Include columns: week identifier from [Opportunity M1 Date] and the cumulative M1 ACV value.
fetchSteps.phaseTitle: M1 ACV Weekly Cumulative Performance Tracking

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 1: Identify Previous Week and Current Week M1 ACV Values
analysisSteps.aggregation: Cumulative M1 ACV value (already calculated in fetch)
analysisSteps.question: What were the cumulative M1 ACV values for the previous week and the current week?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: You are provided with a table containing weekly cumulative M1 ACV values for the current quarter. Each row represents a week with its cumulative M1 ACV from the quarter start. Identify the two most recent weeks in the data. Label the most recent week as 'Current Week' and the week immediately before it as 'Previous Week'. Extract and report the cumulative M1 ACV values for both weeks clearly: 'M1 ACV Until Previous Week: [value]' and 'M1 ACV Until Current Week: [value]'.
analysisSteps.phaseTitle: M1 ACV Weekly Cumulative Performance Tracking

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 2: Calculate Week-over-Week Change and Percentage Change for M1 ACV
analysisSteps.aggregation: Difference and percentage difference between current week and previous week cumulative M1 ACV
analysisSteps.question: What is the absolute change and percentage change in M1 ACV from the previous week to the current week?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Using the cumulative M1 ACV values you identified for 'Previous Week' and 'Current Week' from the data, calculate: (1) Change in M1 ACV = (M1 ACV Until Current Week) - (M1 ACV Until Previous Week), and (2) Percentage Change in M1 ACV = [(Change in M1 ACV) / (M1 ACV Until Previous Week)] * 100. Present the results in a summary format: 'M1 ACV Until Previous Week: [value]', 'M1 ACV Until Current Week: [value]', 'Change: [value]', 'Percentage Change: [value]%'. Provide a one-sentence insight on whether M1 ACV is growing, declining, or flat, and the magnitude of the change.
analysisSteps.phaseTitle: M1 ACV Weekly Cumulative Performance Tracking

phases.phaseTitle: Consolidated KPI Performance Summary and Trend Assessment

fetchSteps.title: Fetch 4: All Three KPIs - Full Quarter Weekly Cumulative Trends
fetchSteps.objective: Retrieve the complete weekly cumulative trend data for all three KPIs across the entire current quarter to enable trend visualization and pattern identification.
fetchSteps.requiredData: Columns: Week identifier, cumulative M1 ACV (from cumulative_sum([Opportunity M1 Starting ACV], [Opportunity M1 Date], quarter_number([Opportunity M1 Date]))), cumulative M1 Count (from cumulative_sum([f Opportunity M1 Created Count], [Opportunity M1 Date], quarter_number([Opportunity M1 Date]))), cumulative S0 ACV (from cumulative_sum([Opportunity S0 Starting ACV], [Opportunity S0 Date], quarter_number([Opportunity S0 Date]))). Filters: All dates at weekly granularity, all dates in 'this quarter', [Opportunity Type] IN ('existing customer expansion', 'new customer'), [Opportunity Deployment] != 'mode'. Note: This may require joining or combining the three separate date-based cumulative calculations into a unified weekly view.
fetchSteps.fetchPrompt: For the current quarter at weekly granularity, retrieve three cumulative KPI values for each week: (1) cumulative_sum([Opportunity M1 Starting ACV], [Opportunity M1 Date], quarter_number([Opportunity M1 Date])) for M1 ACV, (2) cumulative_sum([f Opportunity M1 Created Count], [Opportunity M1 Date], quarter_number([Opportunity M1 Date])) for M1 Count, and (3) cumulative_sum([Opportunity S0 Starting ACV], [Opportunity S0 Date], quarter_number([Opportunity S0 Date])) for S0 ACV. Apply filters: weekly granularity, 'this quarter' for all relevant date columns, [Opportunity Type] is either 'existing customer expansion' or 'new customer', and [Opportunity Deployment] is not 'mode'. Present the data with columns: week identifier, cumulative M1 ACV, cumulative M1 Count, cumulative S0 ACV for each week in the quarter.
fetchSteps.phaseTitle: Consolidated KPI Performance Summary and Trend Assessment

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 7: Assess Overall KPI Trend Trajectory Across the Quarter
analysisSteps.aggregation: N/A (trend analysis across all three cumulative KPI values)
analysisSteps.question: What are the overall trends for each KPI across the quarter, and are they showing consistent growth, acceleration, deceleration, or stagnation?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: You are provided with a table showing weekly cumulative values for M1 ACV, M1 Count, and S0 ACV across the current quarter. For each KPI, analyze the week-over-week progression: (1) Identify if the KPI shows consistent linear growth, accelerating growth (increasing week-over-week gains), decelerating growth (decreasing week-over-week gains), or stagnation/decline. (2) Compare the three KPIs to identify which is performing strongest and which may be lagging. (3) Highlight any weeks with anomalous spikes or drops. Provide a narrative summary describing the overall trajectory of each KPI and their relative performance, concluding with which KPIs are trending well toward targets and which require intervention.
analysisSteps.phaseTitle: Consolidated KPI Performance Summary and Trend Assessment

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 8: Calculate Quarter-to-Date Growth Rate for Each KPI
analysisSteps.groupBy: N/A (calculation from first week to current week for each KPI)
analysisSteps.aggregation: Percentage growth from the first week to the current week for each KPI
analysisSteps.question: What is the quarter-to-date growth rate for each KPI from the start of the quarter to the current week?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Using the weekly cumulative data for M1 ACV, M1 Count, and S0 ACV, identify the first week of the quarter and the most recent week. For each KPI, calculate the quarter-to-date growth rate: [(Current Week Value - First Week Value) / First Week Value] * 100. Provide a one-sentence insight comparing the growth rates and identifying which KPI has the strongest and weakest quarter-to-date performance. If any KPI shows negative or zero growth, flag it as a concern.
